# Host .bashrc lines 118-130, copied verbatim on 2026-10-05.
# The live ~/.bashrc was NOT modified.

if [ -f /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash ]; then
    source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash
fi
alias vlavoice='python3 voice_command.py --mic pulse --min-logprob -0.6 --device cpu'
source /etc/turtlebot4_discovery/setup.bash
export FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE=~/.ros/fastdds_super_client.xml

# VLA: hardware discovery vars only when VLA_MODE=robot is exported first.
# Otherwise every new terminal silently points at the Pi and cannot see
# the simulation — no error, just nothing.
if [ "$VLA_MODE" != "robot" ]; then
    unset ROS_DISCOVERY_SERVER FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE
fi
